channel.title: One Fire Record: Saudi Arabia
channel.description: Is this month's fire activity normal for Saudi Arabia? NASA MODIS and VIIRS fire detections joined into one record since 2000.

item.title: October 2026 in Saudi Arabia: fire activity was above normal
